items.title: Getting 50 GB/S Back from the Apple Neural Engine
items.titleOrig: Getting 50 GB/S Back from the Apple Neural Engine
items.desc: RTL performance erratum in the Apple M3 Neural Engine throttles DRAM weight streaming throughput down to 17–19 GB/s from the nominal 45–60 GB/s. Avoiding the problematic path in the kernel DMA engine's speculative prefetch ring increased Llama 3.2 1B token throughput from 10.0 to 24.3 tokens/s.
